description: Android application code for displaying and managing running processes, including a ListActivity subclass with an adapter for listing processes and handling item clicks to show process info.

classes.name: RunningProcesses
classes.description: Main activity class extending ListActivity, listing running processes and handling item clicks to show process details.

classes.name: AppListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for managing and displaying list of running app processes.

classes.name: ListItem
classes.description: Data holder class for process info.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up adapter, and finishes if no processes.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Lifecycle method, currently just calls super.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Lifecycle method, currently just calls super.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks, starts ProcessInfo activity with process details.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses view for list item and binds data.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Binds process name to TextView in list item view.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Comparator method for sorting process names.
